A Digital Device in My Life
Today, I would like to introduce my smartphone, which is very important for me.
In my daily life, I can use my smartphone to make calls, send messages, and search for information.

Household Robot
With the development of modern science and technology, household robots are now widely used.
There are many kinds of household robots.
Cooking robots are amazing helpers in the kitchen. They can do some cooking and even clean up the
kitchen. These robots are smart and green.
Nursing robots are designed to take care of babies or the elderly. They can talk with them, making
them not feel lonely. However, nursing robots can be expensive for some families.
Cleaning robots are very helpful for keeping our homes tidy. They can clean places we can’t reach
easily. This makes our homes cleaner.
Household robots are becoming more and more popular. I believe that there will be more smart
robots and our life will be more convenient.
例文拓展版：
Household Robot
With the development of modern science and technology, household robots are now widely used.
There are many kinds of household robots.
Cooking robots are amazing helpers in the kitchen. They can do some cooking and even clean up the
kitchen. These robots are smart and green.
Nursing robots are designed to take care of babies or the elderly. They can talk and interact with
them, making them not feel lonely. This is very important for people who need company and care.
However, nursing robots can be expensive.
Cleaning robots are very helpful for keeping our homes tidy. They can vacuum the floors and clean
surfaces and we don’t need to do anything. This makes our houses cleaner and saves our time.
Household robots are becoming more and more popular. As technology advances, I believe we will
see even more types of robots that will make our lives easier and more enjoyable.

Hello everyone. I am Li Hua. Nowadays, electronic devices like smartphones, tablets, and laptops
are popular among students. They bring us not only convenience but also trouble.
Firstly, electronic devices have many advantages. One of the most obvious benefits is that we can
quickly and conveniently search for information. Besides, electronic devices provide us with various
forms of entertainment, such as games, music, and videos.
However, there are also some disadvantages to using electronic devices. One major concern is that
prolonged use of these devices can harm our eyesight. Additionally, excessive use of electronic devices
can negatively affect our social interactions, as we may become less engaged in face-to-face
communication and more reliant on virtual connections.
To ensure the proper use of electronic devices, we need to establish some guidelines. Firstly, we
should limit our screen time and take regular breaks to rest our eyes. Secondly, we should prioritize
real-life interactions over virtual ones, by engaging in activities such as outdoor sports or group
discussions.
In conclusion, electronic devices have both advantages and disadvantages. We should use them
responsibly and in moderation.
That’s all. Thank you for listening.

Problems and Advice on AI
Nowadays, AI makes life and learning more convenient. However, it also brings problems to
teenagers.
One major problem is that some teenagers rely too much on AI when doing homework. Instead of
thinking independently, they just copy answers from AI. Another issue is that excessive use of AI may
reduce teenagers’ ability to communicate face-to-face, as they prefer to get information or solve problems
through AI rather than interacting with others.
To address these problems, here are some suggestions. First, when encountering difficult problems,
teenagers should think independently first and regard AI as a learning aid. Second, they should set a
reasonable time limit for using AI every day and spend more time engaging in real-world activities and
communicating with people around them.
Let’s use AI reasonably so that technology can serve human beings for a better life.

An exchange visit
Last month, our school hosted a group of exchange students for a two-week exchange activity. As a
volunteer, I’d like to report the activity to you.
During the exchange visit, we arranged a variety of activities for the exchange students. They
learned Chinese painting. Under the guidance of our art teachers, they carefully painted traditional
Chinese landscapes and flowers, experiencing the charm of Chinese painting art. They also cooked
Chinese food. They learned to make dumplings, spring rolls and so on. Everyone was very interested and
actively participated in the cooking process. In addition, we also organized a visit to local museums and
historical sites, which helped them have a better understanding of China’s long history and rich culture.
As for how the exchange students felt, they were extremely excited and satisfied. They said that these
activities made them fall in love with Chinese culture deeply. They were impressed by the long history
and unique charm of China. They also expressed their gratitude to our school and all the volunteers for
providing such a wonderful opportunity for them to experience Chinese culture.
In a word, this exchange activity was a great success. It not only promoted cultural exchanges
between us and the exchange students, but also deepened our friendship. Thank you!
